context_for_next_testing_agent: Contract-gen KP fix fully verified. Backend endpoints GET /api/sauna-crm/contract-template/available-kps/{leadId} and POST /api/sauna-crm/generate-contract behave as designed. Modal data-testids used: generate-contract-btn, contract-generation-modal, contract-kp-checkbox-doc:<url>, contract-modal-generate. Note the seeded lead CRM-DOC-TEST is only visible in Список view (client 'QA Doc'), not in the Kanban board.
rca of the issue: Original 504 was due to _gather_kps() doing an unbounded count_documents scanning the massive pdf_data blob on unindexed fields. Fix documents-first ordering + cheap has-pdf existence + max_time_ms caps + new indexes on amocrm_id/id/order_id. The 'КП не найдены' bug was because only calculator ORDERS were being scanned via amocrm_id, ignoring document-attached KPs on the lead; fix now emits DOCUMENT-based KPs first and uses stable kpId 'doc:<url>' / 'order:<id>' so the modal + backend can round-trip attach either kind.
